s: Double-entry bookkeeping service recording all financial transactions with immutable audit trail and balance consistency.
w: Every financial event (charge, refund, payout, adjustment) creates balanced journal entries (debit = credit). The ledger is append-only; corrections are done via reversals, never overwrites. Account balances are derived from entry aggregation. Supports multi-currency, accrual accounting, and reconciliation. Regulatory compliance (SOX, GAAP) requires this immutable record of every money movement.
use: Marketplace or platform requiring financial reconciliation between parties
Subscription billing with proration, credits, and usage-based billing
Audit trail for regulatory compliance (SOX, PCI-DSS)
avoid: Simple payment processing without multi-party settlement (payment_gateway alone suffices)
Non-financial event logging (use event store or audit log)
Real-time balance queries requiring sub-millisecond latency (cache derived balances)

props.currency_precision: Decimal places for currency amounts (typically 2 or 4)

pat.d: Ledger IS an event store: every entry is an immutable event with balance effect.

pits: Rounding errors accumulating over millions of transactions - use proper decimal arithmetic, never floats
Asynchronous webhook delays making balance appear wrong - show pending/settled distinction to users
tips: Double-entry bookkeeping is the answer to 'how do you know the money is right' - always debit and credit
Immutable append-only ledger with reversal entries is the standard pattern - never UPDATE financial records
